issue.title: Gate-capacity end-to-end test failed in parallel check and passed serially
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/fakey/test_gate_capacity_custom_e2e.py::test_synchronous_gate_answer_claims_and_releases_runner_slot_capacity_like_an_agent`
- **Repro:** `just check` (full xdist suite after selection escalation)

It failed once in the broad check and passed on a serial rerun against the unchanged tree. Observed fail rate is 1 of 2 executions; it failed in parallel and passed serially. The broad check ran under heavy shared-host load.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in the broad check and passed on a serial rerun on the same tree (1 failure in 2 observed executions); failure occurred in parallel and passed serially under lower load.

issue.creation_reason: The broad check recorded one failure for this gate-capacity test, while a serial rerun on the same tree passed. I am recording it as a flake for follow-up rather than treating the parallel result as a confirmed failure.

evidence.note: Independent reported impact from sase-1tj.1 note #2: check c8fbf549a33e3fd56ae2869a4674661a also listed test_synchronous_gate_answer_claims_and_releases_runner_slot_capacity_like_an_agent as KNOWN (witness 6a06e0823754c1c7dc7499d26219cc77), outside its docs-only change. During landing on fbfaf07123, the exact node passes serially with the four cancellation nodes and 13 guard tests (18 passed in 6.55s). This corroborates the existing intermittent broad-lane failure report, not a new deterministic defect; retain the existing flake task.
